shortIntro.title: What Kind of Phone Actually Runs Dota Underlords Smoothly ♟️📱
shortIntro.para1: Dota Underlords is not about fast fingers — it’s about fast thinking 🧠. Every round stacks heroes, alliances, gold calculations, and visual effects. A smooth device ensures your brain fights opponents, not frame drops.
shortIntro.para2: As boards get crowded and synergies explode, weak phones start to choke 😬. A capable processor, enough RAM, and stable thermals keep animations clean and menus responsive so your strategy stays sharp.

intro: Below are the updated minimum and recommended requirements to enjoy Dota Underlords on Android and iOS — whether you’re grinding ranked or just chilling with bots 😎.

minimum.Internet: Not mandatory (needed only for ranked & online 🌐)

recommended.Internet: Stable Wi-Fi for ranked & cloud sync (offline still works 😌)

ios_intro: On iOS, Dota Underlords feels especially polished 🍏. Valve’s optimization allows even older iPhones to handle crowded boards without sudden hiccups or UI lag.

ios_recommended.title: Device
ios_recommended.value: iPhone X / XR / 11 series and up

fps_intro: FPS isn’t the star of Underlords — stability is 🎯. Smooth boards mean better planning, cleaner positioning, and zero panic when alliances activate.
settings_intro: Tweaking a few settings can turn a struggling phone into a strategy beast ♟️🔥.

storageIntroText: Underlords is lighter than most competitive games, but it still needs breathing room 📦:
faqIntroText: Common Dota Underlords questions — answered without the headache 😎:

faqList.question: Is Dota Underlords demanding on phones?
faqList.answer: No. It’s well optimized and runs comfortably on most mid-range devices.

faqList.question: Can I play without internet?
faqList.answer: Yes. Offline bot matches are fully playable. Internet is only needed for ranked and multiplayer.

faqList.question: Why does performance dip in late rounds?
faqList.answer: Crowded boards and active synergies stress low-RAM devices. Lower graphics and close background apps.
